approval_basis: Reviewed outside the release automation. Gate canonical digest recomputed independently and matches; 48 of 48 source digests verified against disk; 32/32 matched. (1) v24 negative evidence drove this repair: the frozen attempt on broker job gpuq-f71d1d907fe3 is retained with generated_partition_passed false, 11 recorded passes, 1 recorded failure and 2 unrecorded crashes accounted as 14 = 12 + 2, and it authorizes no claim. Confirmed in emitted source that a reused program coordinate bounded bias[128] by the 256-element matrix axis and now bounds it by the accessed Buffer's own extent D_BIAS_0=128; the verifier enforces len(access.indices) == len(buffer.shape), so the positional index is checked rather than assumed, and AccessMap.indices[position] with the accessed Buffer shape[position] is the sole authority for that bound. (2) The 10-case expectation diff was reviewed item by item against a re-emission under both compilers: the 32-case set is unchanged, only lowering_source_sha256 moved, no accepted, lowering_eligible, findings or schedule_sha256 value flipped anywhere, every changed line is a mask= line, and across 21 mask sites exactly one numeric bound changed - the 256 to 128 repair - while the other 20 are identical-value re-ownings. Removing the two redundant branches I raised, and the follow-up docstring correction, each moved zero lowering digests. (3) The observation instrument's tie-aware audit keeps its pass predicates byte-identical and adds a fail-closed guard that raises when distance rows and index outputs disagree, so a batched index shape becomes an explicit error instead of a silent pass. (4) This Revision does not disguise the recorded gemm-bias failure as passing and does not change tolerance: the new oracle's arithmetic is identical to the retained one and its bias padding is a no-op when bias width equals output width, the mask repair leaves that case numerically unchanged, and the declared 1e-05 tolerance is untouched. The 3.81e-05 accumulation-order deviation over 3997 of 131072 elements remains open and needs a successor brokered B200 run; the checked_cuda_asset partition also remains missing. The 4 focused tests pass. The 30 contract tests currently failing were independently confirmed same-origin: 60 error lines, all either 'released corpus manifest bytes differ' from the v24 lock or 'Compiler release approval does not bind this Gate report', with none outside that class; they are pending-release fail-closed refusals and require a full rerun after the successor lock exists.
